In this video, we explain how we identified this stock using a six-filter growth screen and why it was the only large-cap stock to pass all six filters.
We also break down what GARP, P/E and PEG reveal about its valuation, how the company generates revenue, and why income from its largest business segment has declined,yet FIIs and DIIs have increased their stake.
Additionally, we explore its financial performance, market share across products, the impact of new regulations and its emerging business bets.
